verdict.summary: Round 2 resolves the prior major finding. Unverified duplicate markers are now suppressed from ambiguity only when a trusted issue for the same bd-id exists, while trusted duplicates and unverified-only duplicates still fail closed. The added tests cover the exact prior decoy shape through apply_migration, as well as trusted collisions, unverified-only collisions, unrelated ambiguity, and ambiguous edge endpoints. The touched-id scoping and trusted-map precedence are consistent with the stated threat model, and no new correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue is apparent in the diff.
